content.text: Replace this text and the input_json data with actual validated evidence for this question batch.

questions.name: P01
questions.instructions: What is the primary policy concern based on provided actual rule text and content? Use unknown when evidence does not establish the answer.

choices.description: Unsupported or misleading product efficacy claim.
Potential music, image or trademark rights issue.
No clear risk under supplied applicable rules.

questions.name: P02
questions.instructions: Is there a concrete product efficacy or outcome claim whose representation materially exceeds the evidence supplied? Flag potential risk only, not a definitive policy violation.

questions.name: P03
questions.instructions: Is a product-effect before/after shown as proof without adequate comparability or substantiation in the supplied evidence?

questions.name: P04
questions.instructions: Given the declared sponsorship relationship and platform-specific disclosure requirements, is a required disclosure absent from supplied post metadata?

questions.name: P05
questions.instructions: Does a material advertised product identity, variant or core property contradict the matched listing?
